selection: Retain earlier independent inner selection of high-priority ridge and SVR. Blend their clipped inner out-of-fold predictions. Select lowest inner high-score MAE with overall MAE <= ordinary Small B ridge pooled inner MAE + .05. Ties: overall MAE, smaller SVR share. Without high scores use lowest overall MAE. Endpoint share 0 is always eligible. Outer test predictions never choose settings.
interpretation: Existing survey inputs and real students only. No engineered survey variables or synthetic records. Prediction blending is internal model computation. Original five outer folds repeated five times with four inner folds. Inner validation is reused to choose base hyperparameters and blend share; outer evaluation assesses the complete procedure. Same-sample exploratory follow-up after prior evaluations, not independent confirmation.
